title.narrative: Strengthening Resilience of Agro-Pastoralists in Sindh (SRAS)

description.narrative: The project addresses poverty, food insecurity and malnutrition in Pakistan in the province of Sindh and will reduce the vulnerability of targeted communities to climatic and economic shocks. The overall objective to increased food security and resilience to climatic and economic shocks of smallholder farming households in the districts of Tharparkar and Umerkot.
